title: draba lactea var. glabrescens
intro: Draba lactea var. glabrescens, commonly known as White Whitlow Grass, is a plant species that belongs to the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from coughs, colds, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation, fighting oxidative stress, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. As a result, Draba lactea var. glabrescens is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions and as a natural remedy for respiratory issues.
